🎥🎬: The Return of the Texas Chainsaw Massacre (1995)

After taking a wrong turn on prom night, four teenagers become stranded on the backroads of rural Texas and stumble into the path of Leatherface and his twisted family. What starts as a simple drive home quickly turns into a terrifying fight for survival against a group with terrifying intentions.

As the night descends into chaos, the friends must do everything they can to escape the family’s deadly games before becoming their next victims. Every wrong decision brings them closer to Leatherface’s chainsaw.

Also released as Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation, the film stars Renée Zellweger and Matthew McConaughey in one of the franchise’s most bizarre and memorable installments.
